host = repo / '.local/tool-tasks/native-sort-storage-20261008/harness/OfflineSearchHarness.dll'

sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(control) == 'e1117ccb7f5c5339e9abcc2e7ac29393ea07ff1bd2df88759140f2681467ea98'
assert sha(host) == '65d7d5c136bf9ca527be565a9cc7288430f8398994056c1ac72f31dca097c2e4'

        out = task / 'screen' / root / label

        env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL'] = str(dll)
        meta = {'command':cmd,'environmentOverrides':{'OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL':str(dll)},
                'removedDiagnosticEnvironmentKeys':removed,'requestSha256':sha(requests/(root+'.json')),
                'hostSha256':sha(host),'dllSha256':sha(dll),'outerTimeoutSeconds':120,
                'noProfilerOrCorrectnessInstrumentation':True}
        (out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2))
        start=time.monotonic()

        result=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text())
        harness=json.loads((out/'harness-result.json').read_text())
        metrics=result['solverMetrics']
        current={'root':root,'label':label,'exitCode':p.returncode,'processWallSeconds':time.monotonic()-start,

                 'quality':{k:metrics[k] for k in quality_keys},'qualityScope':'eleven Evaluate fields; no complete Coordinator acceptance',
                 'work':{k:metrics[k] for k in work_keys},'evidence':str(out)}
        if reference is None: reference=(result,harness,current)
        rr,rh,rc=reference
        current.update(qualityEqual=current['quality']==rc['quality'],workEqual=current['work']==rc['work'],
                       rootEqual=result['rootContinuationStamp']==rr['rootContinuationStamp'],
                       liveEqual=harness['search']['rootLiveStamp']==rh['search']['rootLiveStamp'],

        runs.append(current)
        (task/'screen-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(runs,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
        print(json.dumps(current,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
        assert p.returncode==0 and current['status']=='Passed'
groups=[]

                   'maximumCandidateRssOverMinimumControl':max(r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for r in c)/min(r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for r in a),
                   'guardsPass':all(all(r[k] for k in ['qualityEqual','workEqual','rootEqual','liveEqual','budgetEqual','policyEqual']) and not r['timeBoundaryObserved'] for r in rows)})
(task/'screen-groups.json').write_text(json.dumps(groups,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(groups,indent=2),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import bisect, collections, json, re

p=Path('.local/tool-tasks/lazy-mask-layout-roi-20261009')
clock=json.loads((p/'cpu-clock.json').read_text())
logs=[json.loads(line) for line in next((p/'candidate-cpu-run/logs').rglob('process.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()]
start_log=next(x for x in logs if 'GC_SEARCH_ALLOCATION_LIMIT' in x['Message'])
end_log=next(x for x in logs if 'TRANSPOSITION_CAP ' in x['Message'])
offset=clock['monotonic']-clock['realtime']
start=start_log['Time']/1000+offset
end=end_log['Time']/1000+offset
ranges=[]
for line in (p/'cpu-managed-perf.map').read_text().splitlines():
    address,length,name=line.split(' ',2)
    ranges.append((int(address,16),int(length,16),name))
ranges.sort(); starts=[r[0] for r in ranges]
def resolve(addr):
    i=bisect.bisect_right(starts,addr)-1
    if i>=0 and ranges[i][0]<=addr<ranges[i][0]+ranges[i][1]: return ranges[i][2]
    # A return PC may sit immediately beyond a method's last instruction.
    i=bisect.bisect_right(starts,addr-1)-1
    if i>=0 and ranges[i][0]<=addr-1<ranges[i][0]+ranges[i][1]: return ranges[i][2]
    return None
paths=['::Snapshot(', '::BuildProjectedShuffleOrder(', '::StableShuffleProjection(',
       'StrategicEffectContext::Build(', 'SimulationCardPileLookupFastPath::Find(',
       'SimCardPile::Fork(', '::GetBaseHookListeners(', '::GetEffectiveHookListeners(',
       'MirroredHookListenerFilter::Filter(', 'MirroredHookListenerLayout::Matches(',
       '::GetMirroredHookListeners(', '::TryBuildProjectedHookListeners(',
       'MirroredHookListenerFilter::MaskFor(', 'ConditionalWeakTable', 'PredictionForkContext::Register(', 'PredictionForkContext::Find(',
       '::BuildCardStateFingerprint(', '::CanPlay(', '::AdvanceRound(',
       '::BuildChoices(', '::ChoiceCardKey(', '::Replay(', '::Fork(']
total=0; samples=0; no_managed=0; near=collections.Counter(); inclusive=collections.Counter(); stages=collections.Counter()
def consume(header,addresses):
    global total,samples,no_managed
    if header is None: return
    timestamp,cycles=header
    if not start<=timestamp<=end: return
    names=[name for a in addresses if (name:=resolve(a)) is not None]
    samples+=1; total+=cycles
    if not names:no_managed+=cycles
    owned=next((n for n in names if '[CombatSolver]' in n),None)
    if owned:
        label=owned.split('[CombatSolver]',1)[1].strip().split('(',1)[0]
        near[label]+=cycles
    joined='\n'.join(names)
    for path in paths:
        if path in joined: inclusive[path]+=cycles
    stage='Snapshot' if '::Snapshot(' in joined else 'Fork' if '::Fork(' in joined else 'Replay' if '::Replay(' in joined or '::ReplayAction(' in joined else 'Other'
    stages[stage]+=cycles
header=None; addresses=[]
for line in (p/'cpu-frames.txt').read_text().splitlines():
    m=re.match(r'^(\d+\.\d+):\s+(\d+)\s*$',line)
    if m:
        consume(header,addresses); header=(float(m[1]),int(m[2])); addresses=[]
    elif line.strip() and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]+',line.strip()): addresses.append(int(line.strip(),16))
consume(header,addresses)
assert samples>0 and total>0
report={'scope':'short Evaluate diagnosis only; inclusive paths overlap; nearest managed owner attribution is not exact leaf resolution; not full Coordinator timing',
